title: `try`/`catch`/`finally` and `throw` are each one syntax and two `lang` features.
text: `lang:statements/try-catch-finally` and `lang:errors/try-catch-finally` split their facts between their `details.md` files, but their `about.md` files and examples 01 to 03 say much the same. `lang:statements/throw` and `lang:errors/throw` are the same pair. `throw-and-catch.mdx` shows all four under their own headings, and the chapter generator renders all four. Merging a pair deletes a roster id and a chapter heading. It closes when each pair is one feature, with the other id's examples moved or deleted and every citation of it rewritten.
